name: echo_hit
description: Echo trails on the hit: the picture leaves ghosts of where it just was, which fade back to a single picture. Best on a layer that moves (a punch, a slide, a shake) or on fx to echo everything beneath.

count.doc: Echoes behind the picture; each one re-renders the layer (or everything beneath fx), so more costs more.

interval.doc: Time between echoes; negative shows the past.

strength.doc: Echo decay at the peak: each echo is this times the one before.

mode.doc: How the echoes combine: average never brightens (good on full-frame pictures), screen and add glow, max keeps the brightest, over_back stacks the ghosts behind the picture (good on cut-outs).

decay.doc: Time to fall back to the single picture.
